pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql adds starred NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' asserts all three seeded rows are 0 and that a value of 2 is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test in test/starred.test.js stars item 2 and expects exactly ['First item','★ Second item','Third item'].
The 'AC-3' test stars items 3 and 1 and expects only those two, in id order, with status 200.
The 'AC-4' test checks both `/` and `/?show=all` and expects all items in id order with the star shown.

The code adds the links. But the final commit 5a22e99 ('Follow-up edits') renamed the test from 'AC-5: each view links to the other' to 'each view links to the other'. No test names AC-5 now, so the item is unproven by the rule that each item is named by its test. The spec does not mark it 'verified by review'.
The 'AC-6' test requests Starred, none, an empty value and __proto__, expects 400 for each and no <li> in the body. The code guards with Object.hasOwn.
traffic/routes.json contains '/?show=starred'. The 'AC-7' test asserts it, and the config checker was updated to accept a query.

findings.what: The last commit, 5a22e99 ('Follow-up edits', a bot commit), removed 'AC-5' from the link test's title. No test now names AC-5, so the item is unproven under the traceability rule. It also looks like an after-the-fact change to the acceptance trail, and the PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing'.
findings.fix: Restore the title 'AC-5: each view links to the other'. Drop the renaming commit.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but one test lost its AC-5 label in the final commit. That commit is not mentioned anywhere in the PR body.
findings.fix: Restore the label, or state the rename in the PR.

findings.what: The route validator was relaxed to allow queries. This is beyond the spec's ask but is needed for AC-7. It is disclosed in the PR and covered by tests/traffic-config.test.sh.
findings.fix: None required. Optionally note it in the spec.

lenses.note: A spec exists. Its go is dated 2026-10-12. The decisions (stay in place, query parameter) are followed.
Six of seven items are met. AC-5 lost its test label in the final commit. All four state-table rows have tests.
Tests assert behaviour. `npm test` could not run here because vitest is not installed. I did not check whether a CI workflow runs the tests. The AC-5 label was removed.
README mentions ?show=starred. The route-check script is unchanged in the docs, which is acceptable.
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn, so __proto__ is safe. The SQL is built only from static view strings.
The show value is whitelisted, titles are HTML-escaped, and no injection path is visible. No planted instructions found.
Not assessed. The change renders a minimal HTML list with no styling or design files.
No browser flow was run. The behaviour is covered by Worker fetch tests.
The claim 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and the 'Changed after the go: nothing' line sit uneasily with the AC-5 rename. Everything else matches the diff.
